title: fix(app-shell): flow expression notes, the Problems panel and the add-widget picker read the designer locale (objectui#10804)
body:
Fixes #10804
Clause-②: no — the locale is passed and rows are added; each en row equals today's literal, and no declared surface or stored value moves.

objectui#10805 is folded into this card and rides here. Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM (claim `5858412835`, session `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`).

## What changed

All under `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`.

- **Site 1 — `FlowExprIssue`.** `flowScopeNote` passes the designer locale it already holds to `describeUnknownRefs`, as the siblings `FlowEdgeInspector` and `FlowNodeConfigField` do.
- **Site 2 — `previews/flow-expr-problems.ts`.** `checkCel` passes its `locale` to `validateExpressionClient('predicate', value, locale)`. `checkScreenVisibleWhen` takes the `locale` from `flowExpressionProblems(draft, locale)` and passes it to `validateExpressionClient` and to `screenVisibleWhenScopeError`.
  - Bounded in-place fix in the same file, same class and same gates: a row with no label of its own was prefixed by the English column label (`Visible when: …`). The fields are now read through `localizeFlowFields`, the localizer the inspector already uses, so the prefix is the column label the author sees. Evidence is in H1 below.
- **Site 3 — new `engine.*` rows.**
  - `FlowObjectListField`'s `screenScopeGroups` heading reads `engine.flowScope.group.screenFields` (en `Screen fields`).
  - `previews/screen-spec.ts`'s `screenVisibleWhenScopeError` gains an optional `locale` parameter, as `describeUnknownRefs` has one. The undeclared-root sentence reads `engine.flowRef.notAScreenField` and `engine.flowRef.notAScreenFieldWithSuggestion`; each en row is the literal it replaces.
- **Site 4 — the add-widget picker (objectui#10805).**
  - `AddWidgetPicker` reads the designer locale (`useMetadataLocale`, as `FlowExprIssue` does) for its search box, empty text, category headings and type names: `engine.widgetPicker.*`, with en equal to today's literals.
  - The reader is split in `previews/widget-types.ts`. `WIDGET_TYPE_META[].labelKey` is what the picker shows. `WIDGET_TYPE_META[].label` stays the English the stored default `New TYPE` title is written from. `WIDGET_CATEGORY_LABEL` became `WIDGET_CATEGORY_LABEL_KEY`, and its only reader was the picker. The stored `type` does not move.
  - The zh chart names reuse the `packages/i18n` `widgetType` terms (柱状图, 条形图, 折线图, 面积图, 饼图, 环形图, 散点图, 漏斗图, 透视表).
- One changeset, `.changeset/10804-designer-notes-locale.md` (`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`).

## H1 — reproduced on the base, under zh-CN, through the real components

This is a probe run with the base's sources (`fb91ac9b0c`). It mounted `FlowPreview` (Problems panel open) and `FlowNodeInspector` on a screen node, both with locale `zh-CN`.

- Problems panel, every expression message English:
  - checkCel, an edge guard: "Unbalanced parentheses in `(amount > 1`."
  - checkScreenVisibleWhen, a brace: "Reason: It looks like a `{discount}` template brace was used inside a condition — …"
  - screen `visibleWhen` scope: "Approval: `needsApproval` is not a field on this screen"
  - an unlabelled row: "Visible when: `needsApproval` is not a field on this screen"
  - the parse refusal: "Code: invalid CEL predicate: Unexpected token: EOF … — predicates are bare CEL (e.g. `record.rating >= 4`)."
- The inline cell on the same draft showed its brace alert in zh (条件中似乎用了模板花括号 …), while the panel showed the same message in English.
- Screen `visibleWhen` cell notes: "`needsApproval` is not a field on this screen", and the same parse refusal in English.
- The pins' red run on the base (quoted from the failure diffs):
  - `FlowExprIssue`: "Unknown reference `amout` — did you mean `amount`?"
  - screen picker heading: "Screen fields"
  - `dicount` note: "`dicount` is not a field on this screen (did you mean `discount`?)"
  - picker placeholder: "Search widgets…"
  - picker headings: "Single value" / "Charts" / "Tabular"
  - picker entries: "Metric (KPI)" …
  - picker empty text: "No matches."
- Control: the sibling `FlowEdgeInspector` named the same `amout` reference in zh on the base (未知引用 `amout` —— 是否想用 `amount`?). The pin keeps it as a lit control, and it was green on the base.
- On the head, the same probe reads "`(amount > 1` 中的圆括号不配对。", "Reason: 条件中似乎用了模板花括号 …", "Approval: `needsApproval` 不是此页面上的字段" and "显示条件: `needsApproval` 不是此页面上的字段".

## H2 — the `screen-spec.ts` seam

`screenVisibleWhenScopeError(visibleWhen, node, locale?)`: an optional trailing `locale`, the `describeUnknownRefs` shape. An absent locale reads the en rows, so any caller that passes none renders exactly what it did. The call sites:

- the inline cell, `FlowExprIssue`: `screenVisibleWhenScopeError(value, screenNode, locale)`. The component already held `locale` from `useMetadataLocale()` for `validateExpressionClient`.
- the Problems panel, `checkScreenVisibleWhen(value, node, locale)`: `screenVisibleWhenScopeError(value, node, locale)`. `flowExpressionProblems` prefixes the message with the row's own label, or the column label when the row has none. The card's `Reason: ` is such a row label: author data, which passes through.
- the Debug run's screen step, `unevaluableVisibleWhen(node)` in `flow-simulator.ts`: it passes no locale and still renders the en rows, inside that step's English sentence frame. See the Acceptance notes.

## H3 — every reader of `WIDGET_TYPE_META[].label`

| Reader | Reads | Class |
|---|---|---|
| `AddWidgetPicker`: the entry's name and the search filter | `label` before, now `labelKey` | display |
| `DashboardDefaultInspector.addWidget` | `label`, into `New TYPE` (and the selection label echoing that stored title) | stored default |
| `DashboardPreview.handleAddWidget` | `label`, into `New TYPE` (same) | stored default |
| `DashboardDefaultInspector`'s widget rows, `DashboardPreview`'s selected-widget header | `.icon` only | not a label reader |

No display-only reader exists outside the picker, so nothing else was localized. Both stored-default readers keep writing English.

The search matches the name the entry shows, and the stored `type` id printed beside it. It does not match the English name the entry hides.
- Why: the box filters what is on screen. A zh author types the word they see (柱状图), and the id keeps an ASCII handle (`bar`, `pivot`).
- Matching the hidden English would keep entries for a reason nothing on screen shows: under zh, `chart` would keep five entries that show no such word.
- Under en the displayed name is the English one, so en search behaves exactly as before.

## Pins and ablation

The new file is `inspectors/inspectorStrings.i18n-10804.test.tsx`, on the objectui#10696 / objectui#10748 harness: the rendered text of the real component, zh read back from the catalogue and guarded by `zhRow`.

- One zh pin per site, each with an en control:
  - `FlowExprIssue` (decision branch);
  - the screen `visibleWhen` picker heading;
  - the screen `visibleWhen` note (both keys);
  - the Problems panel: checkCel on an edge, the screen brace, the screen scope, and the unlabelled-row prefix;
  - the add-widget picker: search box, headings, every type, empty text, and search by the displayed name.
- Lit controls: the `FlowEdgeInspector` sibling, `engine.inspector.flowNode.kind`, the Problems panel title, and the add-widget trigger.
- en controls for new rows assert the literal English, so they hold on the base too.
- Stored-title control, zh and en: picking the bar entry writes `type: 'bar'` and `title: 'New bar chart'`.

Readings (the pin file held at HEAD):

- **Base sources** (`fb91ac9b0c`, restored by trap; `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes after): `Tests 12 failed | 9 passed (21)`. The 12 are exactly the zh site cases. The en controls, the lit controls and the stored-title control passed.
- **Head** `4024c9b826`: `Tests 21 passed (21)`.
- **Ablation**, via `ablation-replace.mjs`. It dropped the locale at site 1: `describeUnknownRefs(unknown, locale)` became `describeUnknownRefs(unknown)`, anchor x1 → x0, blob `772b9c8255` → `e8abd2db37`.
  - Result: `Tests 1 failed | 20 passed (21)`. The one failure is "FlowExprIssue — … zh: the unknown reference reads engine.flowRef.unknownWithSuggestion", received "Unknown reference `amout` — did you mean `amount`?".
  - The `FlowEdgeInspector` lit control stayed green.
  - Restored: blob == HEAD (`772b9c8255`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

  - Declared narrowing: the whole `metadata-admin` + `studio-design` directory run did not finish inside the 570-second foreground cap (killed, no verdict), so the full package suite is left to CI.

  - Every file is inside eslint's config (`--print-config` exit 0 for each).
  - `--format json`: 8 files, 0 errors, 1 warning. The warning is `react-hooks/refs` in `FlowObjectListField`, on a line this diff does not touch.
  - No type-aware linting is configured, and no `eslint-rules/` rule reads the disk, so this diff cannot move any verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide lint is CI's.

## Serial

- At dispatch (18:05Z, `ff94a12d24`), no open PR touched these files.
- This PR does not touch `ViewPreview.tsx` (PR objectui#10821) or `inspectors/datasetFilterCondition.ts` (seat 4, objectui#10813).
- Before opening, the branch was dry-merged onto a fresh `origin/main` `fda49e557b`: `git merge-tree --write-tree` exit 0, no conflicts. `metadata-admin/` is unchanged between the base and that `main`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The stored default title is left literal on purpose** (the objectui#10678 / objectui#10651 ruling). It is not re-ruled here.
  - `DashboardDefaultInspector.addWidget` and `DashboardPreview.handleAddWidget` keep writing `New ${label.toLowerCase()}` in English under every locale.
  - They are the two other `WIDGET_TYPE_META[].label` readers, and both are stored-default. Neither is a display-only reader, so neither was changed.
- **The card's "plus its parse-refusal text" names no literal in this repo.** `screenVisibleWhenScopeError` returns producer text there:
  - `@objectstack/spec`'s `predicateSlotRefusal` for the shape;
  - `@objectstack/formula`'s `validateExpression` and `collectCelRootIdentifiers` for the parse, which embed the CEL engine's own diagnostic ("invalid CEL predicate: Unexpected token: EOF …").
  - Keying it here would mean a consumer-side match over producer prose, or replacing the producer's English. So it passes through as it is, in every locale, and the new rows' comment says so.
- **The Debug run's screen step** (`flow-simulator.ts`) composes `unevaluableVisibleWhen`'s reasons into an English sentence ("A screen field's visibleWhen may reference only the fields declared on this screen; …"). It is outside this file surface. Its reasons stay on the en rows.
- `AddWidgetPicker`'s `label = 'Add widget'` prop default is unreached: both callers pass the translated `engine.inspector.add.widget`. It is left as is.
- **zh wording.** `Screen fields` became 页面字段: the screen node is 交互页面 and its fields help says 此页面. `Data table` became 数据表格, and `Metric (KPI)` became 指标 (KPI).
